The upper 4K wide-angle camera gives a fixed 122° view of the whole scene, while the lower 2K PTZ camera adds 8x auto-zoom and 360° pan for complete coverage. The S4 PoE add-on camera works exclusively with the eufy PoE NVR system and cannot operate on its own.
When the bullet camera detects a subject, the PTZ lens locks on and follows it in sharp, centered close-ups from up to 164 ft away. Auto-zoom keeps moving subjects framed until they leave the scene.

AI-ISP processing shows nighttime detail in full color without a spotlight. Switch the spotlight on for an even clearer view, and HDR prevents overexposure so details such as a license plate stay readable.
The AI tracks intruders across your property and deters them with a smart siren and a red and blue strobe light.
Advanced AI tells people, pets and vehicles apart and cuts false alerts by 99%, so you are notified only when it matters.
A single cable carries power and data for round-the-clock recording with your eufy NVR S4. A PoE NVR, switch, injector and DC adapter are required and are not included.
IP65 weather resistance stands up to rain and wind for reliable monitoring. AI noise reduction filters out background noise so two-way conversations stay clear.
